title: Binding
description: One company's resolved set of definitions: its answer to every applicable decision, its parameter values, and any convention it overrides. Choices made in advance only — figures observed when the binding is run against data belong in outputs, not here. Selected variants and labels are not stored: they follow from the answers. Bindings live under examples/, never src/.

ontology_version.description: The ontology version the answers were given against.

answers.description: Decision id to answer. Validator: every decision whose applies_when is met (or that has none) is answered; no decision whose applies_when is unmet is answered; each option belongs to its decision.

parameters.description: Parameter id to value. Validator: each key is declared by a decision or metric, the value matches the declared type, and parameters whose required_when holds are set. The properties below are parameters agreed but not yet declared on a node; each moves to its owning node when that node is written.

max_pause_days.description: A paused subscription becomes churn once the pause exceeds this. No default: no market source yet. Owner: d-churn-dating.

dormancy_window_days.description: A returning customer within this window is reactivation; beyond it, new. Separate from max_pause_days. No default: no market source yet.

usage_floor_recompute_months.description: How often the usage floor is recomputed over the trailing usage_floor_window_months. Applies to the trailing-* options of d-usage-recurring-basis only. Owner: d-usage-recurring-basis.

opportunity_max_age_months.description: An open opportunity older than this is stale. What happens to it is decided by d-win-rate-denominator. Default rationale: maintainer's choice, no market source yet. Owner: d-win-rate-denominator.

defaults.description: Conventions: defaults nobody argues about, overridable by those who do, never asked in the guided flow. A key absent from a binding means the convention's default holds.

hierarchy_change_history.description: When customers merge or one acquires another, whether history is restated under the new parent. Default rationale: no sourced market practice was found; restate is what most systems produce implicitly, because CRMs overwrite the hierarchy without keeping history. as-recorded needs effective dates on party.parent_party_id, which the entity model does not carry.

paused_subscription_churn.description: Whether a paused subscription becomes churn once the pause exceeds max_pause_days.

paused_churn_date.description: Where churn from an over-long pause is dated. pause-start backdates it, so closed periods can change. Interacts with d-churn-dating.

allow_grain_fallback.description: Where a party has no ancestor at the grain chosen in d-customer-grain, whether the party itself is treated as the customer (true, as customer.yaml describes) or excluded and flagged (false). The count of parties affected is reported in outputs, not stored here.

capitalised_commissions.description: Cash versus amortised commissions in CAC. Deliberately untyped: a likely ADR-0005-style composition case, to be settled with d-cac-scope.

source.description: Whether the default was accepted or chosen deliberately.
